about: Hole 8: aiming for 'that chili bowl in the back', 'swear to god if I get a hole in—I'm in the bunker', you putt out of the bunker like always, 'pretty pleasant par' coming… miss → 'no, oh that's devastating, absolutely devastating.' Longer story bit; you're far from the camera for the last putt. Original audio, swearing kept, no added text, vertical 1080x1920.
